title: PlanetScale Database
description: A PlanetScale serverless MySQL-compatible database with branching, deploy requests, and schema management capabilities.

id.description: The unique identifier of the database.

name.description: The name of the database. Must be unique within the organization.

state.description: The current operational state of the database.

plan.description: The billing plan for the database.

cluster_size.description: The cluster size identifier for the production branch.

default_branch.description: The name of the default production branch.

production_branch_web_console.description: Whether the web console is enabled for production branches.

insights_enabled.description: Whether PlanetScale Insights analytics is enabled for the database.

migration_framework.description: The migration framework configured for tracking schema changes.

migration_table_name.description: The name of the migration tracking table.

require_approval_for_deploy.description: Whether deploy requests require approval before deployment.

allow_data_branching.description: Whether data branching is enabled, allowing branches to include data copies.

created_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the database was created.

updated_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the database was last updated.

html_url.description: The URL to the database in the PlanetScale dashboard.

Region.description: A geographic region where PlanetScale databases and branches can be hosted.

slug.description: The region slug identifier used in API requests.

display_name.description: The human-readable name of the region.

Branch.description: A database branch representing an isolated copy of the schema for development, testing, or production use.

id.description: The unique identifier of the branch.

production.description: Whether this is a production branch.

ready.description: Whether the branch is ready to accept connections.

shard_count.description: The number of shards in the branch.

cluster_rate_name.description: The cluster size identifier for the branch.

parent_branch.description: The name of the parent branch this was forked from.

schema_last_updated_at.description: The timestamp when the branch schema was last modified.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the branch was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the branch was last updated.

DeployRequest.description: A deploy request for applying schema changes from a development branch to a target branch, similar to a pull request workflow.

id.description: The unique identifier of the deploy request.

number.description: The sequential deploy request number within the database.

branch.description: The name of the source branch containing schema changes.

into_branch.description: The name of the target branch to deploy into.

state.description: The current state of the deploy request lifecycle.

approved.description: Whether the deploy request has been approved for deployment.

notes.description: Notes or description accompanying the deploy request.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was last updated.

closed_at.description: The timestamp when the deploy request was closed, or null if still open.

Password.description: A connection credential for authenticating to a database branch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the password.

name.description: A descriptive name for the password.

role.description: The access role that determines read/write permissions.

hostname.description: The hostname for connecting to the database with this password.

username.description: The username for the database connection.

database_branch.description: The branch this password provides access to.

expires_at.description: The expiration timestamp, or null for non-expiring passwords.

renewable.description: Whether the password expiration can be renewed.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the password was created.

ServiceToken.description: A service token for authenticating PlanetScale API requests programmatically.

id.description: The unique identifier of the service token.

name.description: A descriptive name for the service token.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the service token was created.

ServiceTokenAccess.description: A permission grant associated with a service token, scoped to a database or organization.

id.description: The unique identifier of the access grant.

access.description: The permission identifier, such as read_branch, write_branch, or delete_branch.

database.description: The database the access is scoped to. Null for organization-wide access.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the access was granted.

Backup.description: A point-in-time backup of a database branch.

id.description: The unique identifier of the backup.

state.description: The current state of the backup process.

size.description: The size of the backup in bytes.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the backup was initiated.

completed_at.description: The timestamp when the backup completed, or null if in progress.

expires_at.description: The timestamp when the backup will expire.

WebhookConfig.description: A webhook configuration for receiving event notifications from a PlanetScale database.

id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook.

url.description: The HTTPS URL that receives webhook POST callbacks.

events.description: The list of event types the webhook subscribes to.

active.description: Whether the webhook is currently active.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the webhook was created.

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the webhook was last updated.
